content.title: Automatically install Background Security Improvements on iPhone - Apple Support
content.text: iOS 26 iOS 18 iOS 17 iOS 16 Select version: iOS 26 iOS 18 iOS 17 iOS 16 Modifying this control will update this page automatically Search this guide Clear Search Table of Contents Automatically install Background Security Improvements on iPhoneBackground Security Improvements provides additional protection to your iPhone in between software updates.Important: In rare instances of compatibility issues, these security improvements may be temporarily removed and then installed in a future software update.Turn on Automatic Install for Background Security ImprovementsGo to Settings > Privacy & Security > Background Security Improvements, then turn on Automatically Install.Learn more about Background Security ImprovementsGo to Settings > Privacy & Security > Security Improvements, then tap Learn More.See alsoUpdate iOS on iPhone Helpful?
